name: DUMBBELL SIDE BEND LEFT
introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Put your left hand on your waist and have your right hand hold a dumbbell at your side. \n\nBend your body to your right side and lower your right hand towards the floor. Pause for one second and return to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Inhale when you bend down, and exhale when you go back to the starting position.
